environment.description: Application deployed as an ECS Fargate task behind an internal ALB. The ALB is fronted by CloudFront with an origin request policy. A PostgreSQL 14 RDS instance is accessed through RDS Proxy configured with IAM authentication. The RDS Proxy target group connects to the database using a Secrets Manager credential for a user 'app_readonly'. The database user 'app_readonly' is configured with a restricted search_path and has ONLY been granted EXECUTE on a single function: hr.search_employees(text, text) which uses parameterized internal queries. The user has NO direct SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE privileges on any table. pg_hba.conf on the RDS instance (via custom parameter group) restricts the 'app_readonly' role to connections originating only from the RDS Proxy's ENI CIDR. The RDS custom parameter group also sets log_statement='all' and statement_timeout=3000.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14.9, db.t3.medium, custom parameter group
config.db_user_privileges: EXECUTE ON FUNCTION hr.search_employees(text, text) ONLY; NO table-level grants; search_path = hr, pg_catalog
config.pg_hba_override: hostssl hr app_readonly 10.0.4.0/24 scram-sha-256 (RDS Proxy ENI range only)
config.network: private subnets only, ALB internal, CloudFront origin
config.cloudfront: origin request policy strips query strings over 512 bytes
